reviewer: independent model_deep_dive subagent; did not implement these runtime controls
scope: Read-only review of runtime opt-ins, boot integration, packaging, cache/workflow triggers and claims; subsequent edits only clarify runtime documentation. No deployment or runtime source changes.
reviewed_controls: Thread parsing rejects values outside 0..256 and applies explicit budgets before setup/model work; zero leaves native selection unchanged.
Disabled terminal/cast flags do not import or install optional optimization helpers.

Terminal helper bytes, pipeline source and scheduler source/exact class gate installation; failures restore original class call method. Per-step schedule/index/dtype/conditioning guards retain original prediction when unsupported.

GPU cast checks helper bytes, exact processor class, inherited method identity and method source hash; failures restore original processor method. The patch is instance-scoped and CPU tensors use the original converter.
Production leaves duplicate cast-comparison mode disabled. Runtime inference errors use existing error handling, without a second speculative inference.
Docker copies the runtime and both exact helpers after dependency installation; helper changes invalidate source layers, not dependency layers. Existing compiler cache hydration remains unchanged.

Docker ignore rules retain the copied runtime/helpers. Main-branch workflow path filters include all added runtime/helper files; the reviewed branch does not itself auto-publish through the main push trigger.

validation.execution_scope: CPU-only local tests; no Torch/CUDA/model execution. Tests were run during the preceding independent review and not repeated for these wording-only changes.
validation.additional_checks: worker_runtime.py and inference_server.py parsed and compiled successfully without execution.

documentation_corrections: Four-thread setting explicitly rejected for the current quality-preservation goal.

Individual-file deployments must include worker_runtime.py and exact bench/terminal_noop.py plus bench/gpu_output_cast.py; inference_server.py alone is insufficient even with optimization flags off. Rebuilt image is the alternative.
limitations: Review assumes one pipeline instance per Python worker and one-time boot configuration. These functions are not promised as dynamic or idempotent runtime toggles; restart the worker after configuration changes.

Full GPU proof of the integrated production opt-ins across all intended resolutions/steps remains pending; passing CPU guard tests does not establish speed, output equality or application performance.

Terminal-noop finite-output equivalence is not universal: zero multiplied by a nonfinite original prediction need not equal removing that prediction. Source guards do not replace workload quality testing.
Existing package resolution and compiler-cache behavior were not rebuilt or benchmarked in this review. Diffusers is source-pinned; other pre-existing dependency/weight-fetch behavior is unchanged.
A future push to main or explicit workflow dispatch can publish the image; no such action was taken in this review.
TORCH_NUM_THREADS=0 preserves the environment-native choice, which is not guaranteed to be 128 on every host. Lower thread budgets remain unaccepted for the present exact-quality goal.
